why_relevant: Podgorica-based Standard Media outlet with an economy section; broadens the local-press net beyond the four largest outlets and occasionally carries bank-executive interviews.

Registry-derived profile of the association as a legal entity (NGO registered 7 April 2003, Novaka Miloševa bb, Podgorica), giving founding date, identifiers and possibly filed financials — useful for provenance and for locating the association's registered filings.

source_name: EEAS / EU Delegation to Montenegro — payments & SEPA statements
why_relevant: EU Delegation publishes the political framing and donor-programme announcements around SEPA inclusion and Growth Plan disbursements; useful for dating commitments and identifying funded projects.

entity_name: Mastercard Crna Gora official Facebook page
source_name: UBCG Facebook/social presence via bankar.me page (event and statement mirror)
why_relevant: Association assembly sessions and member-bank gatherings are announced/photographed on sector social pages before the website is updated; useful low-latency signal on committee activity and event occurrence.

source_name: ATTF Luxembourg — training partner of UBCG
why_relevant: Long-standing technical-assistance partner delivering seminars to Montenegrin banks; seminar programmes reveal which payment/card capability gaps the sector is addressing.

Leading Montenegrin business-consulting firm explicitly serving banking clients; produces sector studies, feasibility work and SME surveys that occasionally quantify merchant acceptance and financing behaviour.

Niche Montenegrin portal focused on prices, money and household finance; carries cash-holding and central-bank cash-policy items in Montenegrin (e.g. coverage of a central bank advising households to hold cash), which is a distinct cash-usage sentiment signal.

source_name: Stellar Market Research — Montenegro Banking System Market (commercial syndicated report)
why_relevant: Example of the commercial syndicated-report layer covering Montenegro banking/payments (sizing and forecasts). Low methodological transparency but useful to map who sells ME-specific market reports and what they claim; comparable vendors (GlobalData 'Cards and Payments' series) publish per-country editions for regional peers.

source_name: TendersInfo / GlobalTenders / TendersOnTime / MontenegroTenders - commercial Montenegro tender feeds incl. contract awards
why_relevant: English-language commercial feeds that mirror ME notices and, importantly, contract AWARDS - useful for supplier identification when the official portal's award section is hard to query. Keyword pages exist for niche categories, indicating an indexed back-end.

source_name: Visa corporate — Visa Perspectives / trends & insights (CEMEA regional economic outlook)
why_relevant: Visa's own regional commentary combines cardholder spend data with tourism economics for CEMEA/SEE; Montenegro appears as part of the regional narrative rather than a standalone dataset, but supplies scheme-authored context and occasionally country-level figures.
